Yellow-Tufted Dacnis raised $100 for Rainforest Trust (w/a lifetime donation of $1306!) Thanks everyone for making this happen- you all ROCK! 🐡

Team Hosmer is ready for Bike MS ROC the Great Lakes tomorrow! We're in 2nd place for fundraising & I've been mocked for not being in 1st. Please help us raise $ for the Nat'l MS Society!

National Parks of Lake Superior Foundation is participating in Give to the Max Day, a nonprofits raffle with a $100,000 prize pool of grant money.
The Lake Superior Marine Museum Association is spending $75,000 on upgrades this year. The group is raising money and writing grants to help defray the costs.

We have less than two hours!! I am matching up to $140 to get my sister's Bike MS ROC the Great Lakes fundraiser to $5,000, so she can reach Passport Rider status for 2026.

Firelands Indivisible and Great Lakes, Good Trouble volunteer, Ruthann N Parker has been working very hard to set up two different town halls in January. We need to fundraise a little bit to get enough money to pay for a facility for these events. Any amount will help!

UM senior Brendan LaFrenier is running across the entire state to raise money to address homelessness! He'll run from Lake St. Clair to Lake Michigan, in support of shelters in Detroit, Ann Arbor, Lansing and Grand Rapids. You can support him at

From April 21-25, one of our members, Teichner Law , a public interest environmental law firm in Traverse City, will generously donate $5 to the Great Lakes Business Network for every signature we receive. Sign on today! support.nwf.org/page/81811/a...

The Great Lakes Bay Veterans Coalition delivered a donation of personal hygiene items valued at an estimated $11,908 to the VA Saginaw Healthcare System this year.

Final hours. At midnight tonight, the $20,000 dollar-for-dollar match ends. Your gift right now can help to protect the Great Lakes and the millions who rely on them. If you’ve been waiting to give, this is your chance.

There’s still time to double your impact for the Great Lakes. Right now, every gift is matched dollar for dollar, up to $20,000, helping to protect clean drinking water, shorelines, and communities across the region. The match ends at midnight.

$84,200 boost for Great Lakes United Football Club community Great Lakes United Football Club will receive $84,200 to upgrade drainage, improving safe, reliable field access for players, volunteers and families.

Northern News Now reports that Lake Superior College in Duluth has received a $185,864 state grant to launch PACE, which aims to provide students with intellectual and developmental disabilities with skills in communication, financial literacy, employment, and independence. #AccessPress
